w: Swamishri departed from Mumbai at 12.25 pm and arrived in Rajkot at 1.05 pm. In the evening Swamishri blessed the huge satsang assembly in Rajkot and then departed for Gondal.
Swamishri performed pujan of murtis for the Swaminarayan Sanskar Bhavan in Ramod, district Rajkot.
A young boy called Yogi asked Swamishri, "Bapa, you are always busy all day. When are you free?"
"Do you see me free during the day?" Swamishri asked lovingly.
"No. But I would like you to say yes or no," Yogi insisted.
"Whenever you come I'm free," Swamishri replied.
"When you are free what do you think about?" Yogi enquired.
"I chant God's name, do bhajan, write letters and bless the devotees."
Then Yogi offered a donation to Thakorji. Swamishri blessed him and instructed, "Study well. Do not fall into the habit of addictions. Serve your parents. And do satsang."
Swamishri gave prasad and blessed Yogi.

To please Bhagwan Swaminarayan and Guru Pramukh Swami Maharaj children, youths and senior devotees perform austerities, pilgrimages or other devotional means. The spiritual endeavors performed by the devotees during Swamishri's visit to the local centers are congratulatory and worthy of recognition. It also reflects Swamishri's divinity for inspiring such spiritual efforts in children, teenagers and devotees.
8 November 2003, Bochasan On the occasion of Punam and symbolic celebration of Swamishri's 83rd birthday celebration a large number of devotees had pilgrimaged by foot to Bochasan.
From Atladra 3 sadhus and 18 youths walked 50 km.
From Nondhana 25 devotees walked 72 km.
From Vasna (Khambhat region) 60 devotees walked 35 km.
From Kayavarohan 33 devotees walked 75 km.
From Vadodara 55 devotees walked 55 km.
From Ambada (Padra region) 40 devotees walked 60 km.
From Latipura (Padra region) 35 devotees walked 45 km.
From Dali 35 devotees walked 50 km.
From Boriavi 8 devotees walked 40 km.
From Narayan Lat devotees walked 50 km.
From last 26 years 18 youths have been cycling 111 km from Mirsapura to Bochasan.
11 November 2003, Bochasan
Six kishores and kishoris of Bochasan observed a waterless fast (nirjala upvas) for 108 hours and 20 BAPS volunteers and 50 women devotees observed a waterless fast for 83 hours.
12 November 2003, Bochasan
Fourteen youths cycled 30 km from Khambhat.

The evening celebration assembly’s theme revolved around the hardships that Shastriji Maharaj, Yogiji Maharaj and Swamishri had borne in establishing and developing the Sanstha. The assembly commenced with Viveksagar Swami’s speech on Shastriji Maharaj. Then Satyaprakash Swami talked about Yogiji Maharaj’s efforts and Gnanpriya Swami spoke about Swamishri’s endeavours. After a bhajan by sadhus Kothari Swami addressed the assembly. The youths then performed a traditional dance. Thereafter, Swamishri was honoured with garlands. A brief video on 100 years of BAPS Sanstha was shown. Finally, Swamishri blessed the packed assembly hall, “The proof of the knowledge of Akshar and Purushottam was the descent of Shriji Maharaj who came to give this knowledge. Then Gunatitanand Swami revealed that Maharaj is Purushottam Narayan and that he himself is Akshar. He declared this to the world – the knowledge of Akshar-Purushottam, Brahma-Parabrahma, Swami-Narayan and Bhakta-Bhagwan. This is the tradition of India.”

Pragnesh (6 yrs) observed an 108-hr liquid fast; Rashmin Parmar and Pratap Chauhan observed waterless fast for 100 hrs, Harikrishna Ranpara (72 hrs), Dinesh Amipara (24 hrs) and Siddharth Parsana (50 hrs). Many devotees observed liquid fasts: Ramesh Kholiya, Kishore Gohil and Rakshit Kheraiya (200 hrs); Siddharth Parsana and Pravin Ramani (187 hrs); Devraj Hirani, Mihir Chotaliya, Vishal Gediya and Jayesh Dakshini (100 hrs); Jitendrasinh Vala (144 hrs), Kartik Gediya (125 hrs), Alkesh Parikh (87 hrs) and Kirit Belar 36 hrs. Sharad Kacha refrained from ghee, cooking oil and salt. Umang Bhatt ate only one meal a day ( ektana ) for four months. Many female devotees observed different types of austerities: 20 women observed waterless fasts for 100 hrs, 25 women observed a 100-hr liquid fast, 5 women observed khatras , 550 women observed a chain of waterless fasts for 42 days. One female devotee observed dharna-parna for 100 days. 78 women devotees performed dhun, mantra jap, mantra lekhan , Janmangal Namavali, pradakshina and dandvat . They also chanted non-stop dhun for 100 hrs.

ds.t: No trouble on New Year's Day
w: Yagnavallabh Swami phoned from America. He was to have two devotees receive blessings on the phone. He said to Pramukh Swami Maharaj, "Bapa! We are troubling you on New Year's Day."
Swamishri said, "It is the New Year. There is no trouble. There is no problem in talking so that devotees receive blessings and their troubles are removed; go ahead."
Whether it is the first day of the year or the night of the last day, Swamishri is always eager to remove the sorrows of devotees, and he never tires of it.
Yagnavallabh Swami phoned from America. Two devotees were to receive blessings over the phone. He said to Pramukh Swami Maharaj, "Bapa! We are troubling you on New Year's day."
Swamishri said, "It is the New Year. There is no trouble. There is no problem in talking so that devotees receive blessings and their troubles are removed. Go ahead and talk."
Whether it is the first day of the year or the last night of the year, Swamishri is always eager to remove the suffering of devotees, and he never tires of it.

Today after the mangala arti, as Mahant Swami Maharaj was coming down in the lift after having darshan everywhere, he began to say of his own accord, "The sadhus who were bowing at my feet are each like a warrior. They have grappled with maya."
Hearing this, Dharmavallabhdas Swami prayed, "Please bless us that we win."
"All will win a brilliant victory," Swamishri said with a gesture of both hands. From these words of his everyone can draw wonderful warmth and courage.

ds.t: From the moment the letter is written
w: Today, during the reading of letters, there was a letter from a devotee in Vadodara. The baby in his wife's womb was upside down. The doctor had said, "If it does not turn by the 11th, a caesarean will have to be done." So he had asked in his letter for blessings that "the baby turns the right way."

But in the order of letters, that letter came up today, and today was the 11th. So everyone was in a dilemma about what to do now. Finding a way out, Shrutipriyadas Swami asked, "Swami! Shall we give the blessings by phone?"
Mahant Swami Maharaj said "Yes". So the phone was dialled. But then the devotee said, "From the very day the letter was written, the desired change in the womb had begun, and now everything is fine."
As soon as he heard this, Swamishri too said, "I had it in my mind that it must have turned already!"
Hearing this, everyone was stunned.
Shrutipriyadas Swami asked, "Swami! Even if, due to time and circumstances, we cannot get a letter to you,
does the devotee's wish begin to be fulfilled from the moment he writes the letter?"
"Yes," Swamishri said, briefly but firmly.
In this yes of his lies an unparalleled reassurance for all satsangis.

Today Mahant Swami Maharaj left Rajkot and arrived near the Limbdi mandir. Here sadhus and devotees were eager to welcome him with garlands. Seeing them, Swamishri lowered the window. So all the sadhus and devotees began garlanding him and quickly moving on.
Referring to one person among them, Swamishri pointed his hand backwards and said, "That Vora..."

Hearing this, a Vora gentleman standing a little way behind was called. Swamishri lovingly greeted him with "Jai Swaminarayan". He too, having darshan with great feeling, said, "A month ago you gave me darshan in a dream."

Then, as there was a hurry, Swamishri quickly met all the devotees through his glance. The car began the journey to Bochasan. But the attendant sadhus were curious. So they phoned the sadhus in Limbdi and asked, "Do you know about that Vora gentleman?"
"We don't even know him, but he is still standing here. I'll give the phone to him." Saying this, the phone was handed to the Vora gentleman.
The sadhus asked him, "What is your name?"
"Mustafabhai."
"You spoke about a dream, didn't you?"

"Yes, a month ago today I had a dream. Exactly as it happened today. Mahant Swami Maharaj came in a car in front of the Limbdi mandir just like this. He was welcomed and he greeted me with 'Jai Swaminarayan'. Exactly like today."
Hearing this, the sadhus' curiosity doubled. So they asked, "So since when have you been in contact with satsang?"

"I didn't even know that Mahant Swami Maharaj was coming today. I had come from Surendranagar to meet my friend Raghuvirsinh Zala. He was coming to drop me back when we learnt that Swami was coming. So we stopped for darshan and the dream came true!!" Saying this, the brother put down the phone.
Now only Swamishri could supply the missing link.
So the sadhus asked him, "Did you know that Mustafabhai?"
"No."
"Then how did you call him?"
"Just like that."
"So you went to give him darshan a month ago, didn't you?"
"Bapa must have gone."
"So, knowing his heart, you fulfilled his wish, right!"
Swamishri, in a soft voice, saying neither yes nor no, put a full stop to the matter, but for all who knew of this power of his, there was no stopping their joy today.
Today after the welcome assembly, when Mahant Swami Maharaj came to his residence, Atmaswarupdas Swami said, "Wherever you go, you please everyone."
"Our principle is to please everyone," Swamishri said. In this opinion of his was an introduction to his personality.
In the car on the way to the airport to go to Mumbai, Hariprakashdas Swami asked Mahant Swami Maharaj, "Swami! What time did you wake up this afternoon?"
Swamishri said, "At 2:00."
"Can't you sleep?"
"No, no..."
"You wake early in the morning and you also wake early in the afternoon. Don't you get tired?"
"Tired of what?"
"When one gets older, one gets more tired and also sleeps more. So what is the reason that you sleep less?"
"There is an eagerness for bhajan. I want to chant God's name," Swamishri said.
The urge for bhajan is so strong that it can push even sleep aside!!

Mahant Swami Maharaj sat down for the cheshta singing. As usual Swamishri was about to stretch out his legs, but he asked for the sofa to be turned at an angle. The reason was that in front were the murtis of Akshar Purushottam Maharaj and the guru parampara. What subtle decorum!

yt: Tapomurti Shri Nilkanth Varni Murti-Pratishtha Mahotsav
